Title: Create valid percent coupon
Preconditions: Logged in as admin; code not yet in use
Steps: 1. Go to Mã Giảm Giá tab 2. Fill all fields 3. Click Tạo mã
Expected_Result: New row appears in table: WELCOME20 | Phần trăm | 20% | 100.000 ₫ | 2099-12-31 | 1 lần; form resets to blank
Notes: Baseline happy path for percent type

Title: Create valid fixed-amount coupon
Preconditions: Logged in as admin; code not yet in use
Steps: Fill all fields, click Tạo mã
Expected_Result: New row appears: FLASH50K | Cố định | 50.000 ₫ | 200.000 ₫ | 2099-06-30 | 2 lần
Notes: Baseline happy path for fixed type

Title: Delete an existing coupon
Preconditions: A coupon named WELCOME20 already exists (e.g. from TC-ADM-01)
Steps: Locate the WELCOME20 row, click its Xóa button
Expected_Result: Row for WELCOME20 is removed from the table after the list refreshes
Notes: Validates the 'Xem/Xóa' half of FR-17; scope the Xóa locator to the row - the label is reused on every admin tab

Title: Duplicate coupon code rejected
Preconditions: A coupon with code SAVE10 already exists in the system (sample data)
Steps: Fill form with the already-used code SAVE10, click Tạo mã
Expected_Result: Error alert shown (e.g. 'Lỗi: ...'); no duplicate row is added to the table

Title: Empty coupon code blocks submission
Steps: Leave code blank, fill the rest, click Tạo mã
Expected_Result: HTML5 'required' validation blocks submission; no POST request sent

Title: Empty discount value blocks submission
Steps: Leave discount value blank, click Tạo mã
Expected_Result: HTML5 'required' validation blocks submission; no POST request sent

Title: Empty expiry date blocks submission
Steps: Leave expiry date blank, click Tạo mã
Expected_Result: HTML5 'required' validation blocks submission; no POST request sent

Title: Discount value of zero (not positive)
Steps: Enter 0 as discount value, click Tạo mã
Expected_Result: Client currently allows submission (no min='1' constraint on this field - known gap); backend MUST reject with an error per FR-17 'discount_value (dương)' and no row should be created
Notes: Documents a client-side validation gap; the real assertion is on backend behavior

Title: Negative discount value
Steps: Enter -15000 as discount value, click Tạo mã
Expected_Result: Client currently allows submission (no min constraint - known gap); backend MUST reject the negative value and no row should be created

Title: Minimum order amount at boundary zero
Steps: Set min order amount to 0, click Tạo mã
Expected_Result: Coupon created successfully; row shows '0 ₫' for Đơn tối thiểu (spec allows min_order_amount >= 0)
Notes: Validates the inclusive >= 0 boundary is accepted, not rejected

Title: Negative minimum order amount
Steps: Set min order amount to -50000, click Tạo mã
Expected_Result: Client currently allows submission (field isn't even marked required/min - known gap); backend MUST reject and no row should be created
Notes: Also exposes that min_order_amount lacks the 'required' attribute entirely, contrary to FR-17's required-field list

Title: Max uses per user below minimum (0)
Steps: Set 'Số lần dùng tối đa/người' to 0, click Tạo mã
Expected_Result: HTML5 min='1' constraint blocks submission (or backend rejects if bypassed); no row created

Title: Percent discount value exceeding 100%
Steps: Enter 150 as the percent discount value, click Tạo mã
Expected_Result: Behavior undefined by spec - document actual result (accepted vs rejected); logically a >100% discount should not be allowed
Notes: Spec is silent on an upper bound for percent type - flag as a finding either way

Title: Non-admin token blocked from coupon creation API
Preconditions: Have a valid JWT for a regular (non-admin) user
Steps: Send POST /api/admin/coupons directly with the regular user's Authorization header (bypassing the UI)
Expected_Result: Request rejected with 401/403; no coupon is created
Notes: API-level test for FR-12/SEC-03 - role must be checked server-side, not just token presence

Title: Coupon code auto-uppercased on input
Steps: Type the code in lowercase ('flashsale') into the code field
Expected_Result: Field value visibly converts to 'FLASHSALE' as it's typed (onChange forces toUpperCase); submitted/stored code is uppercase
Notes: Confirms client-side normalization matches the checkout page's matching uppercase behavior
